subject: Acme POC: access provisioning, success criteria, and next steps

Subject: Acme POC: access provisioning, success criteria, and next steps

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment going into the POC:

Success criteria (what Acme wants to validate during the 3-week POC)
- End-to-end inference latency under 250ms p95 for the customer support reranking flow at your test QPS (target baseline: 5 qps).
- Embedding similarity recall >= 92% vs current vector store baseline on the provided eval set (50 queries).
- No customer data leaves your VPC (we'll run Redwood Private connector for the trial).

Evaluation plan / ownership
- Week 0 (this week): Access & provisioning — SSO invites, API key for staging, IP allowlist. Owner: Marissa (redwood SE).
- Week 1: Ingestion + integration — set up embeddings pipeline and sample reranking. Owner: Priya / Acme eng.
- Week 2: Load & latency tests + evals — joint test harness run with Redwood. Owner: Nikhil (performance lead).
- Week 3: Final report + next steps (pricing/ Dedicated sizing). Owners: Samir + Rishi (sales).

Immediate asks from Acme (from call):
1) Please send the list of staging service accounts / emails that need SSO invites (ok to include one test account).
2) Confirm the staging IPs to add to our allowlist for initial API access.
3) Any specific privacy/compliance checkpoints for the Private deployment (we'll surface SOC2 artifacts).

I've attached our short POC runbook and a mutual action plan. I'll provision a scoped API key for your staging project and send SSO invites once you provide the user list.

Attachments: redwood-poc-setup.pdf, acme-mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting you set up.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
